title: The Stolen Lightning Movement
summary: Hong Chen's sneak attack ends with all of his meridians snapped, leaving him crippled. Elder Shen Yun of the Wind Lightning Pavilion recognizes Xiao Yan's Three Thousand Lightning Movement as a technique once stolen from the pavilion. He demands that Xiao Yan come with him or be crippled. Han Chi stands by Xiao Yan, but Xiao Yan refuses to drag the Han family in. Shen Yun, a Four-Star Dou Zong, is held off by Xiao Yan's Dou Zong-level puppet, while Xiao Yan fights Hong Li, a Half-Step Dou Zong, and then the whole Hong family, wrecking half of Sky Stone Stage. Hong Li sends for the clan elder Hong Tian Xiao, said to be a Five-Star Dou Zong. When Hong Tian Xiao arrives, Xiao Yan already has Hong Li in his grip and threatens to kill him.
events: Hong Chen is crippled after his sneak attack; Hong Li vows to kill Xiao Yan.
Han Chi invokes the rules of Sky Stone Stage.
Shen Yun says the Three Thousand Lightning Movement was stolen from the Wind Lightning Pavilion.
Xiao Yan refuses to go to the pavilion and keeps the Han family out of it.
Xiao Yan's Dou Zong-level puppet holds off Shen Yun.
Xiao Yan fights Hong Li and then the whole Hong family.
Hong Li sends for Hong Tian Xiao, a Five-Star Dou Zong.
Hong Tian Xiao arrives to find Xiao Yan holding Hong Li hostage.
cultivation: Shen Yun is a Four-Star Dou Zong. Hong Li is a Half-Step Dou Zong. Hong Tian Xiao is said to be a Five-Star Dou Zong. Xiao Yan is still a Dou Huang.
